name: Federal Heat
description: The feds showed up at your door. This ain't about parking tickets.

chapters.title: The Knock
chapters.description: 6 AM. Loud knocking. You look through the peephole and see suits. FBI badges. They're asking about your old neighborhood, your associates, things you thought were buried. They're building a case.

choices.label: Talk to Them
choices.description: Maybe if you answer their questions, this goes away.

choices.label: Lawyer Up
choices.description: Don't say a word without representation. This is serious.

choices.label: Shut the Door
choices.description: You don't have to talk to them. Maybe they'll move on.

chapters.title: The Snitch Label
chapters.description: Word got out you talked to the feds. Someone saw them leaving your spot. Now it's on blogs. Other battlers are calling you out. Someone made 'FREE [YOUR NAME]... from his own mouth' shirts.

choices.label: Address It On Stage
choices.description: Your next battle is your platform. Clear your name in front of everybody.

choices.label: Lay Low
choices.description: Let it blow over. Focus on the case, not the optics.

chapters.title: The Charges
chapters.description: Your lawyer got the paperwork. RICO conspiracy. They're saying you had a leadership role. The prosecutor wants to make an example. Maximum: 20 years.

choices.label: Take It to Trial
choices.description: You're not admitting to anything. See you in court.

choices.label: Consider Plea Deal
choices.description: Your lawyer says they're offering 5 years. Guaranteed. vs. 20 possible.

choices.label: Cooperate Fully
choices.description: Give them what they want. Names. Dates. Walk free.

chapters.title: Caught Slipping
chapters.description: They got you at a venue. In front of everybody. Cameras were rolling. You're in cuffs while fans record. It's everywhere within the hour. This is worse than if you'd just talked to them.

choices.label: Post Bond
choices.description: Get out and fight this from outside.

choices.label: Can't Make Bond
choices.description: You don't have that kind of money. Sit tight.

chapters.title: Case Building
chapters.description: You're laying low but the case isn't going away. Your lawyer says the feds have tapes. Wiretaps. They've been listening for years.

choices.label: Prepare Your Defense
choices.description: Build the best case you can. This might go to trial.

choices.label: Start Negotiating
choices.description: See what kind of deal they'll offer.

chapters.title: Prove It On Stage
chapters.description: Your battle is tonight. Everyone's watching to see how you handle this. The crowd is 50/50 - some support, some came to see you fail. Your opponent has been posting 'snitch' bars all week.

choices.label: Own Your Truth
choices.description: Address it directly. Explain your side. Make them understand.

choices.label: Just Rap
choices.description: Don't give it energy. Let your bars speak.

chapters.title: The Deal
chapters.description: 5 years federal. No parole. But it's better than 20. Your lawyer says take it. Your family says take it. Your career might survive 5 years. It won't survive 20.

choices.label: Take the Plea
choices.description: 5 years. You can come back from 5 years.

choices.label: Reject It
choices.description: You're not guilty. Take it to trial.

chapters.title: Day in Court
chapters.description: Federal courthouse. Media outside. Battle rappers in the gallery. This is either your vindication or your downfall. The prosecutor has tapes. Your lawyer has doubt. The jury has your fate.

choices.label: Take the Stand
choices.description: Tell your story. Make them see you as a person, not a case number.

choices.label: Stay Silent
choices.description: Don't give them anything to twist. Let your lawyer work.

endings.title: Beat the Case
endings.description: Not guilty on all counts. You walked out of that courthouse to cameras and cheers. 'He beat a RICO' is legendary status. Your next battle sold out in 10 minutes.

endings.title: Did Time
endings.description: 5 years federal. No parole. You're calling your manager from inside. Battles cancelled. Album shelved. But you'll be back. The culture remembers those who come back.

endings.title: Maximum Sentence
endings.description: Guilty. The judge gave you 15 years. You fought and lost. Should have taken the plea. Your career is over unless the appeal works.

endings.title: Paper Trail
endings.description: You walked. Charges dropped. But everyone knows why. You gave names. The streets have a long memory. Some leagues won't book you. Some battlers won't battle you. You're alive and free. Is it worth it?

endings.title: Cleared Your Name
endings.description: You addressed it head-on and the culture respected it. Case eventually dropped for lack of evidence. The snitch rumors died down. You came out stronger.

endings.title: Under a Cloud
endings.description: Case got dropped but the rumors never fully went away. Some people believe you, some don't. You battle on, but there's always that asterisk next to your name.
